root.name: Root Chakra
root.description: Your foundation and feeling of being grounded

root.imbalanced: You may feel anxious, fearful, or disconnected from your body
root.affirmation: I am safe, secure, and grounded in the present moment
root.activities: Walking barefoot, gardening, yoga poses like Mountain Pose

sacral.imbalanced: You may feel emotionally numb, lack creativity, or experience guilt
sacral.affirmation: I embrace my creativity and allow my emotions to flow freely
sacral.activities: Dancing, swimming, creative arts, hip-opening yoga poses

beginner.name: Box Breathing
beginner.description: A simple technique to calm your nervous system

instructions.intro: Find a comfortable seated position. Close your eyes.
instructions.step1: Inhale slowly through your nose for 4 counts
instructions.step3: Exhale slowly through your mouth for 4 counts

instructions.intro: Sit comfortably with your back straight
instructions.step2: Inhale quietly through your nose for 4 counts
instructions.step4: Exhale completely through your mouth for 8 counts
instructions.repeat: This is one breath cycle. Repeat 4 times.
